notes: Tap a step to see it clearly: shell commands show just the command with its exit status, and file changes render as a red/green diff with line numbers instead of raw JSON.
A dot now appears on the menu bar icon when a chat finishes in the background, and the menu lists up to four recently finished chats so you can jump straight back to them.
The model picker lists the models your Codex and Cursor accounts can actually use — with each model's thinking levels — and a Refresh Models button to update the list.
Fixed image attachments failing with a "JPEG renderer could not be created" error; images attach again.
The menu bar icon now stays a steady white while a task runs instead of dimming toward the accent color.
The "Done" notch no longer replays when you close the panel after a reply finished while it was open.
Messages written while a chat is working now join that chat's queue and continue processing even after you switch conversations.
Queued messages can be reordered, deleted, or edited through the main composer before they run.
Editing the next queued message pauses dispatch safely, restores your previous draft and attachments afterward, and resumes on save or rollback.
Long queues show two full messages plus a preview of the next and scroll in place instead of continuously growing the panel.
The last working folder now persists across new chats, relaunches, and app updates.
Update Now installs the update immediately — download, install, and relaunch with progress shown, no Install / Remind Me Later / Skip dialog.
Opening Settings > About now checks for updates automatically, so an available update appears without clicking Check for Updates.
What's New shows one set of notes: the update being offered, or the installed version when you're up to date.
The app checks for updates every 6 hours instead of once a day, matching how often release notes refresh.
Provider, model, thinking level, and bypass-permission choices now persist across restarts and new chats.
Switching chats preserves drafts, attachments, messages, and background work; running chats show a spinner in history.
The collapsed notch follows the last-opened chat while queuing background questions, permissions, and completions in order.
Long drafts now scroll to keep the newest text visible as you type, and chat history is ordered by the latest sent message.
Scrolling up in the chat pauses auto-scroll so you can read while a reply streams in below; scroll back to the bottom or send a message to resume following.
ChatGPT replies now render tables natively.
ChatGPT replies now show images and charts instead of dropping them.
Source citations in ChatGPT replies show as clean labels instead of leaking raw link text.
The current tool step shows a spinner while it runs.
You can attach files while a response is still running.
Settings now opens reliably instead of occasionally shifting focus without appearing.
New "What's New" section in Settings > About shows release notes when you check for updates.
Checking for updates from the menu bar opens the About tab instead of a separate popup.
Selected controls in Settings use your macOS accent color.
Shortcut rows show a pencil to signal they can be rebound.
Haptic feedback now double-taps the trackpad when a response finishes.
Tidied Settings: removed the theme descriptions, the Keep panel pinned option, and the About tagline and link.
